summary: A dashboard panel of values over time: each series a line, over a fading or solid area or alone, side by side or stacked, or in steps; a reference series dashed; a threshold scale's steps as dashed lines across, each in its color with its figure; and a legend under the chart as a row of entries or a table of each series' min, max, mean and current value. It stands in the dashboard panel's frame (parts/dashboard-panel: title, info, menu, export, expand, data view, loading, empty and failed) and draws parts/chart's line, area or step kind. The key to a threshold scale, ThresholdLegend, is drawn by the app beside it, as a list of bands or one strip.

anatomy.frame: The dashboard panel's frame around it (parts/dashboard-panel), spanning span of the dashboard grid's columns.
anatomy.chart: The chart (parts/chart), as tall as bodyClassName (192 by default) and as wide as the frame: the area kind, line without a fill, step with step.
anatomy.series: Each series a line in its color (its color token, else the chart's palette), over an area fading from the color at 40 percent of the card to 4 (gradient), or at 15 percent (solid); stacked, each area solid at 55 percent, so each band reads against the one under it.
anatomy.reference: A series marked dashed: a dashed line 1.25 wide with no area, a reference such as a target or the period before.
anatomy.thresholdLine: Each threshold after the first, a dashed line 1 wide across the chart at its value in its color token, its figure written at the line's end over it at chart-text-size-small: a target or a limit. The first threshold has no line; it colors what is below the second.
anatomy.legend: Under the chart (legend list): a wrapping row of parts/chart's legend entries; legend table: a list table of each series with legendStats (min, max, avg, current by default); legend none: no legend.
anatomy.thresholdLegend: ThresholdLegend, where the app puts it: the key to a threshold scale, as a list (each band a swatch, its name with labels, and the range it covers in muted-foreground, 16 apart across and 4 down) or a bar (the bands end to end in one strip 8 tall, 1 apart, rounded radius-mini, the values where they meet written under the joins and the bands' names under them). An optional title over it at weight 500; with noData, a hatched swatch for a missing value.
anatomy.thresholdSwatch: A band's swatch in the list, 12 square, rounded radius-mini, in its color token, with a 1 wide inset ring in foreground at 15 percent; the missing value's is hatched in muted.

x.does: The time of each value, written for a reader.

series.does: Each series: { name, values (a figure or null per time), color? (a color token), stack?, dashed? }. Kept stable between renders.

fill.does: Lines alone, lines over a fading area, or lines over a solid area. Stacked, gradient draws solid.

stacked.does: The series drawn on top of each other.

step.does: Steps from value to value, the step kind.

thresholds.does: A threshold scale ([{ value?, color }], a color token each), its steps after the first drawn as dashed lines across. The same scale colors a stat tile, a gauge or a scorecard's cells, and ThresholdLegend keys it.

decimals.does: Places each figure is written with; format writes them instead.

min.does: Where the value axis starts; max where it ends.

labelEvery.does: Labels every nth time on the axis; ECharts picks when left out.

legend.does: The legend under the chart as a row of entries, a table of each series' figures, or none.

legendStats.does: The figures a legend table shows, in order.

span.does: How many of the dashboard grid's columns the panel spans (SPAN in DashboardGrid).

frame.does: The frame's options, passed through: title, subtitle, info, actions, menu, loading, empty, file, fullscreen, expanded with onExpandedChange, and the data view's data, defaultView, view and onViewChange (parts/dashboard-panel).

thresholdLayout.does: ThresholdLegend's layout: a list of bands, or one strip with the values under its joins.

thresholdLabels.does: ThresholdLegend: a name per band, in order, such as Behind, Close and On target.

noData.does: ThresholdLegend: adds the swatch for a missing value, with words.noData or the app's label.

chart.note: bodyClassName h-48 by default; the app may give another height.

thresholdLegend.note: The title, then the bands, 4 apart.

thresholdBand.note: The swatch, the name and the range, 6 apart.

thresholdBar.note: The strip; the joins' values on a row 16 tall under it.

solidFill.note: fill solid: the area at this opacity of its color; stacked 0.55 (kinds/categories.ts).

rest.means: The series over the times, the threshold lines across, the legend under the chart.

stacked.means: The series stacked, each area solid so each band reads against the one under it.

hidden.means: A series switched off by its legend entry or row: not drawn, the rest kept on their scale (parts/chart, hidden).
hidden.reached: a press, Enter or Space on its legend entry

noData.means: ThresholdLegend's swatch for a missing value: hatched in muted, its label in muted-foreground.

rest.note: The step's own color token where it names one, which the app gives; muted-foreground where it names none (kinds/axes.ts stepMarks).
The title, a figcaption, at weight 500.
In the band's color token, which the app gives (tokenVar).

noData.note: Hatched at 135 degrees, 2 of muted and 2 clear (a repeating gradient of --muted), so no ground of its own.

keyboard.does: Hides or shows a series from its legend entry or its row's toggle in the legend table (parts/chart).

appText.title: The panel's title, and its subtitle and info (parts/dashboard-panel).
appText.series: Each series' name, in the legend, the tooltip and the data view.
appText.thresholdLabels: Each band's name in ThresholdLegend, and its title.

sokkel-ui: The panel shapes its props into rows and draws them with Chart and a kind (area, line or step), so it looks as the kind does (series.ts seriesSpec, legendItems); the frame is ChartFrame.
category, series and value name the data view's columns (usePanelFields in series.ts), defaults written inline.

ThresholdLegend's words are a private default object in ThresholdLegend.tsx (WORDS, ThresholdWords); a band's range writes its values with formatValue (en-US grouping) and the unit, or the app's format.
The threshold lines ride on an unseen series of their own (markSeries), so hiding a series in the legend never takes them with it.

drift.today: As of b7e1763, TimeSeriesPanel draws its mark (a target line across the chart); the series' fills, stacking, steps, the dashed references, the legend and its table, ThresholdLegend and the frame are not built.
